name: spagogo-order-app
description: Food ordering site with Paystack payments, Supabase accounts and a Gemini chat assistant

paragraphs: Ordering and payment site for Fatima Spagogo, a small spaghetti-delivery kitchen in Ibafo & Mowe, Ogun State, Nigeria. A customer picks a meal, pays with Paystack (card / bank transfer / USSD) or with an international card through Stripe Checkout, and the kitchen receives a paid order on WhatsApp — no unpaid orders, no price set by the browser.

Live demo (Paystack and Stripe, both in test mode): Paystack test card: 4084 0840 8408 4081, any future expiry, CVV 408, PIN 0000, OTP 123456. Stripe test card: 4242 4242 4242 4242, any future expiry, any CVC. No real money moves either way.
Operating notes for whoever runs the site (accounts, secrets, backups, what to do when something breaks) are in HANDOVER.md.

requirements.text: Kitchen board (staff.html, unlinked): staff log in with the same accounts and see the orders scheduled for today (or all orders) with payment state, phone/WhatsApp links and address; they move each order New → Preparing → Out for delivery → Delivered (or Cancel).
